messages.subject: [Bug Report] "color" not accepted in theme_line
parts:
I can use "color" instead of "colour" except in theme_line(). So:


> old <- theme_update(panel.background = theme_rect(fill = "white"), panel.grid.minor = theme_line(color = "white"))
Error in theme_line(color = "white") :
unused argument(s) (color = "white")
> old <- theme_update(panel.background = theme_rect(fill = "white"), panel.grid.minor = theme_line(colour = "white"))
>
